proposed_branch: Refine and explicitly compare a P6_3mc (No. 186) BaMnO3 realization against the submitted P6_3/mmc model, allowing independent Ba and O z coordinates and using the same profile/background/displacement model.
reason: The submitted P6_3/mmc CIF is valid: it symmetry-expands to full-occupancy Ba2Mn2O6 (10 atoms, Z=2) in the stated primitive hexagonal cell, has sensible complete coordination shells and Ba2+/Mn4+/O2- bond valences, indexes all important lines, and its instantiated atomic profile is close to a free-intensity bound. However, the trace's claimed lower-symmetry check actually tested only Ba/Mn swapping. A concrete P6_3mc polar subgroup model with the same cell, composition, multiplicities, and extinction-compatible line set converged reproducibly from independent starts to nonzero Ba/O z displacements, retained plausible Mn-O and Ba-O distances, and improved the same whole-profile norm from 0.03885 to 0.03868 (free-intensity bound 0.03802). This is a diffraction-supported, materially distinct symmetry/coordinate realization absent from the submitted set, so the exact structure is not yet sufficiently established.
